common_threshold_rule.step_1: Find the maximum mean validation F1 across the five seeds.
common_threshold_rule.step_2: Define a near-optimal plateau containing thresholds no more than 0.0005 below the maximum mean F1.
common_threshold_rule.step_3: Within the plateau, prioritize the highest worst-seed F1.
remaining_tie_breakers: smallest distance from the median seed-specific optimum
